changelog:
- Switched API Key management to always read from environment variable YOUCLOUD_API_KEY; local file/config input is no longer supported.
- Updated setup instructions to specify setting YOUCLOUD_API_KEY as an environment variable (with examples for Linux/macOS and Windows).
- Removed handling for API Key writing/reading from local config files.
- No other execution rules or API behavior were changed.
